summary: comments work on far more posts, and warm-up now tells you when a newer extension is out
changes: a post from your keyword search can now get a comment even when its caption never repeats your keyword. before, a caption had to contain every word of a keyword, so most posts got no comment.
those comments never name your keyword, since the post may not say it. posts asking for keyword replies or giveaway entries, and sensitive or heated posts, are still skipped.
sat keywords now count as study posts, so their comments sound like study comments.
the side panel and the warm-up site show an update notice when your extension is older than the newest version. chrome never updates it for you.
if follows keep falling short, update first: since 0.6.61 each session starts somewhere new in your results instead of replaying posts you already liked and accounts you already follow.
replace the files in your original extension folder, reload the extension and reopen warm-up.
